_about: Footstep loudness (dB) by surface and gait, read by src/client/sound_stage.gd at start. Edit and restart. Final step level = surface_db + gait_db + surface_gait_db[surface][gait]. Quiet is more negative. A missing or broken file falls back to the built-in numbers. Table: sound/STEP_LEVELS.md (python3 tools/step_levels.py).
